name: Joshua Gabriels
bio: Joshua Gabriels serves as President and Chairperson of Hephzibah Delight Global Mission, providing strategic leadership, organizational direction, and oversight of the organization's mission and programs.

He brings over 10 years of experience in accounting, finance, financial management, and organizational improvement. He holds a Master of Science in Accounting from Bridgewater State University and a Bachelor of Science in Accounting and Finance, graduating Cum Laude.
His commitment is to advancing educational opportunities, vocational training, skills development, and economic empowerment, particularly for underserved communities across Africa.
